items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We did a number of television shows at the time. The Jackie Gleason Show, The Dinah Shore Show, The Garry Moore Show, Carol Burnett.

ctx.x: You’re at Birdland at the nighttime. You go and do something for Prestige in the day, or whatever.

Right, exactly. And I wasn’t signed up with any recording company, so I could record with the Basie band. I could record with anybody, Prestige, Blue Note, or whatever. I was going to say something else. We did a number of television shows at the time. The Jackie Gleason Show, The Dinah Shore Show, The Garry Moore Show, Carol Burnett. We did a bunch of TV shows. Those paid very well, so I had supplemental income that really --
So it’s like a pie really.
